name: Chennai Meenakshi Multispeciality Hospital Limited
about: Chennai Meenakshi Multispeciality Hospital Limited operates a multi-specialty hospital in Chennai, India. It also sells pharmacy products. The company was formerly known as Devaki Hospital Limited and changed its name to Chennai Meenakshi Multispeciality Hospital Limited in November 2007. Chennai Meenakshi Multispeciality Hospital Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Chennai, India.
